newsitem.title: EU: 021014 OVR - BC-TEXT-OJ-L 174 Official Journal contents - OJ L 174 of July 2, 1997.
newsitem.headline: 021014 OVR - BC-TEXT-OJ-L 174 Official Journal contents - OJ L 174 of July 2, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
COMMISSION DECISION of 1 July 1997 terminating the anti-dumping proceeding concerning imports of certain luggage and travel goods originating in the People's Republic of China (97/412/EC)
